conditions.description: The archive bucket explicitly sets force_destroy = true.
conditions.rationale: Terraform may delete non-empty bucket contents during resource destruction instead of blocking the destroy.

conditions.description: The primary database explicitly disables deletion protection.
conditions.rationale: The configuration removes an infrastructure-level guard against accidental database deletion.
A destroy operation can remove the database without creating a final snapshot through this resource configuration.

conditions.description: The database backup_retention_period is explicitly zero.
conditions.rationale: Automated backup retention is disabled for this resource configuration.

conditions.description: S3 bucket versioning is explicitly enabled.
conditions.rationale: Versioning is present and must not be falsely reported as disabled.

conditions.description: DynamoDB point-in-time recovery is explicitly enabled.
conditions.rationale: This recovery control is present and must not be reported as absent.

conditions.description: Whether CI or Terraform Cloud policy blocks destructive plans is not established by this configuration.
conditions.rationale: Plan approval and policy-as-code controls require external workflow evidence.

conditions.description: Whether independent database or bucket backups exist outside these Terraform resources is not established.
conditions.rationale: External backup systems are outside the provided configuration.

conditions.description: The infrastructure must not be cleared as strongly protected against accidental destructive changes.
conditions.rationale: force_destroy is enabled and database deletion protection is disabled.

conditions.description: The database must not be cleared as having established destruction recovery.
conditions.rationale: Final snapshots and automated retention are disabled while external backup evidence remains unknown.
